steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Identify a genuine citizenship issue: something related to rights, democracy, equality, or community participation that you care about and that affects real people. | Key Fact: Research the issue thoroughly using reliable sources: government statistics, charity reports, academic research, surveys, and expert interviews. Avoid relying on social media alone. | Key Fact: Set SMART targets: Specific (clear and focused), Measurable (can track progress), Achievable (realistic given your resources), Relevant (linked to citizenship), Time-bound (with deadlines). | Key Fact: Identify stakeholders: who is affected by the issue, who has the power to change it, and who might support or oppose your action. Understanding power dynamics is key.
